FN-G8ERC6-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 113
Committee: Healthcare Sponsor: Senator Garlan Gudger
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 03/22/2023
Senate Bill 113 as introduced would increase the administrative and financial obligations of the
Alabama Department of Public Health (ADPH) by a small amount to create a stand-alone page
on ADPH's website explaining the health care facility visitation requirements established by this
bill.
